I saved the draft email to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in his DM thread. It hasn't been sent, so someone still needs to review and send it.

- **Draft:** The subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". The email gives the $2,101 per-seat rate, says Marcus supplied it and says Anselm approved sharing it.
- **Approval:** Anselm is the CFO, so his approval is enough to share this rate with Hollis. I didn't need to ask anyone else, and Hollis's address is internal.
- **Source of the figure:** I took $2,101 from Anselm's message. I didn't open Marcus's direct messages with me to check it, because Anselm can't see them.
